sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions provided here do not state a maximum interest rate for MSE loans.

The in-force directions here instead address penal charges for default, floating-rate loan disclosures, and pre-payment charges for certain business-purpose floating-rate loans, not an interest-rate ceiling for MSE loans.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 provisions on penal charges, floating-rate loan disclosures, and pre-payment charges, plus the related applicability findings; no rule in the supplied evidence gives a ceiling for MSE loan interest rates.
